forum.title: HAL_Delay - out by 1ms ?
forum.best_answer_content:
*> It's as if the delay is actually the HAL\_Delay parameter plus 1ms.*

That's exactly what it does here. Since the tick resolution is 1ms. it needs to have a buffer of 1ms to guarantee the minimum wait time. The argument is the *minimum* delay.

HAL\_Delay(1) will delay between 1-2 ms. If you call it repeatedly in a tight loop, it will delay exactly 2ms on average.

[stm32f4xx-hal-driver/Src/stm32f4xx\_hal.c at eaa636c7be367100405b2109023c6dbb12429b98 · STMicroelectronics/stm32f4xx-hal-driver](https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/stm32f4xx-hal-driver/blob/eaa636c7be367100405b2109023c6dbb12429b98/Src/stm32f4xx_hal.c#L395)

If you need more precision, consider overloading HAL\_Delay with your own more precise code. Using a TIM or the DWT->CYCCNT is popular.
